title: Remaining production findings closed
result: the date-filtered reports list pages and counts every report in the range (`getReportsInDateRange`); a report message is recorded and moved only after all its reports ingest, and is otherwise left in place for the next poll with one error line; the standalone output ships the GeoIP updater script, and CI fails if it ships `src/`, `test/`, `docs/` or `.git` again; `backfillReportEvents` filters unusable source IPs before aligning; hostname lookup exceptions go through the logger.
evidence: `pnpm run check:ci` exit 0 on the integrated main (149 files, 781 tests); `test/reportsDateRangePaging.test.ts`, `test/finalizeAfterIngest.test.ts`; each change reviewed separately.
